facts.statement: Levnesovia is a genus of hadrosauroid dinosaur related to Bactrosaurus.
The type species of the genus Levnesovia is L. transoxiana.
facts.quote: The type species is L. transoxiana.

facts.statement: The genus name Levnesovia honors Russian paleontologist Lev Nessov, while the species name transoxiana refers to the ancient region of Transoxiana.
facts.quote: The genus name honours the late Russian paleontologist Lev Nessov, and the specific name refers to the ancient region Transoxiana.

facts.statement: Fossils of Levnesovia include partial skulls, jaws, and numerous postcranial bones.
facts.quote: It is known from partial skulls, maxillae, dentaries and numerous bones of the postcranial skeleton.

facts.statement: Levnesovia lived during the Late Cretaceous (Turonian) in the Bissekty Formation of Uzbekistan.
facts.quote: Levnesovia is a genus of hadrosauroid dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous (Turonian) Bissekty Formation of Uzbekistan.

facts.statement: Levnesovia is the oldest well-documented taxon referable to Hadrosauroidea.
facts.quote: Levnesovia es el más taxón más antiguo bien documentada referible a Hadrosauroidea.

facts.statement: Adult Levnesovia is distinguished from its younger relative Bactrosaurus by a high sagittal crest on the parietals and the absence of dorsal vertebrae spines ending in tubercles.
facts.quote: Se diferencia de algo más joven y pariente cercano Bactrosaurus de la Mongolia Interior en China por una cresta sagital alta en los parietales y la ausencia de espinas dorsales de las vértebras terminadas en forma de tubérculo en especímenes adultos.

facts.statement: Levnesovia is classified within the superfamily Hadrosauroidea.
Levnesovia belongs to the clade Hadrosauromorpha.
Levnesovia lived between 93.9 and 89.8 million years ago during the Turonian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Turonian to Turonian (93.9 to 89.8 million years ago)

facts.statement: It is debated whether Levnesovia, Bactrosaurus, and Gilmoreosaurus represent the earliest radiation of Hadrosauroidea, which may have occurred during the Cenomanian-Turonian in Asia and possibly North America.
facts.quote: Levnesovia, Bactrosaurus y Gilmoreosaurus representa posiblemente la radiación más temprana de Hadrosauroidea, que ocurrió durante el Cenomaniense -Turoniano y posiblemente también en Norteamérica.

rejected.statement: Levnesovia transoxiana lived about 90 million years ago during the Turonian stage of the Cretaceous in what is now Asia.
rejected.quote: Levnesovia transoxiana es la única especie conocida del género extinto Levnesovia... que vivió a mediados del período Cretácico, entre 90 millones de años, desde el Turoniense , en lo que es hoy Asia.
